finalText:
Redis went down and took the whole service with it.

| time (UTC) | event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections |
| 02:14:07 | cache disabled, reads fell back to the store |
| 02:14:10 | first `TimeoutError: request timed out after 5000ms` |
| 02:29:12 | backlog passed its cap of 500 |
| 02:31:44 | worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | supervisor killed the api, service down |

No request succeeded after 02:14:03. All 13 reconnect attempts got the same refusal. Collapse took 17 minutes start to finish. Fix redis first, then add load shedding.
